MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 16

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

11. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

13. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
